finding.claim: The /fetch handler passes the user-supplied `target` query parameter straight to http.Get and returns the response body. An attacker can make the server request arbitrary URLs, including internal services, localhost, and cloud metadata endpoints such as http://169.254.169.254/. This is full-read SSRF, because the body is copied back to the caller.
